content: WikiQA BIBREF8 is an open-domain question-answering dataset. Following He and Lin he-lin:2016:N16-1, questions without correct candidate answer sentences are excluded, and answer sentences are truncated to 40 tokens, resulting in 12k question-answer pairs for our experiments.
